user.title: Hildebrand Glow Account
user.description: Enter your Hildebrand Bright app credentials.

select_entity.title: Select Your Meter
select_entity.description: Select the Bright meter site you want this Home Assistant integration to monitor.

tariff.title: Energy Tariff Configuration
tariff.description: Enter your energy tariff rates. These can be changed later.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the Glowmarkt API.
error.no_resources: No smart meter resources found for this location.

abort.already_configured: This account and meter site are already configured.

settings.title: Hildebrand Glow Settings
settings.description: Change tariff values and API polling intervals. Polling below 5 minutes is blocked to protect the Glowmarkt API.

reset_history.title: Reset imported Hildebrand history
reset_history.description: This removes only Hildebrand Glow statistics and the integration's local backfill/tariff cache for this meter site. Credentials, entity registry entries, dashboards and unrelated Home Assistant history are preserved. After confirmation the integration reloads and rebuilds its history from Glow.

error.reset_failed: The Hildebrand history reset failed. The existing configuration has been preserved.
error.reload_failed: History was reset, but the integration could not be loaded again. Reload the integration from Settings after checking the logs.

abort.reset_complete: Reset complete. {count} Hildebrand statistic IDs were cleared and the integration has been started again for a clean backfill.
